summary: Frank Lara's 2016 article in Liberation News (PSL) called AIPAC "the premier lobby and promoter of Israeli interests in the U.S." and framed that year's election around the Palestinian struggle. Vote for Peace, a candidate rating guide evaluating human rights and war-lobby funding, listed him as an Ally in the 2026 general. His South San Francisco school-board platform centers on class sizes, teacher pay, and safe-schools policy.
